Item: 1987 Taiwan Cinema Manifesto (《1987 臺灣電影宣言》)
Creator: Edward Yang, Hou Hsiao-hsien, Wu Nien-jen, et al.
Historical Context: before the end of Martial Law
Subject: Taiwan New Cinema,Institutional Reform
Description: A landmark manifesto signed by 54 Taiwanese filmmakers and intellectuals in 1987. It fiercely criticized the rigid, state-controlled film industry and commercial monopolies, calling for 'another kind of cinema.' This document acts as the ideological catalyst for Edward Yang's eventual departure from the studio system to pursue true independent filmmaking.
